mapper.select: INSERT INTO entity_aliases (novel_id, card_id, alias, card_name, card_kind, is_primary) VALUES (#{novelId}, #{cardId}, #{alias}, #{cardName}, #{cardKind}, #{primary}) ON CONFLICT (novel_id, alias) WHERE is_deleted = FALSE DO UPDATE SET card_id = EXCLUDED.card_id, card_name = EXCLUDED.card_name, card_kind = EXCLUDED.card_kind, is_primary = EXCLUDED.is_primary, update_time = now() RETURNING 1

SELECT id, novel_id AS "novelId", card_id AS "cardId", alias, card_name AS "cardName", card_kind AS "cardKind", is_primary AS "isPrimary", create_time AS "createTime", update_time AS "updateTime" FROM entity_aliases WHERE novel_id=#{novelId} ORDER BY card_kind, card_name, is_primary DESC, alias

SELECT id, novel_id AS "novelId", card_id AS "cardId", alias, card_name AS "cardName", card_kind AS "cardKind", is_primary AS "isPrimary", create_time AS "createTime", update_time AS "updateTime" FROM entity_aliases WHERE novel_id=#{novelId} AND alias=#{alias} LIMIT 1
